findings.location: §8 독립 확인과 생활 전이 — '답은 B. A는 분모100명과50명을...'
findings.problem: The independent source-comprehension choice displays its answer and all three explanations immediately after the options. §5's cover-the-model instruction is scoped to its six expression groups; §8 only delays the later writing example. Reading B is not independent comprehension evidence.
findings.proposal: Move '답은 B' and its KO/EN/DE explanations to a facilitator/check-after-response block. Before the choices add KO '먼저 답과 해설을 모든 언어에서 가리고 A–C 중 하나를 고른 뒤 이유를 말해요. 답을 본 뒤의 시도는 지원 연습이에요.' EN 'Hide the answer and explanations in every language before choosing A–C and explaining why. An attempt after seeing the answer is supported practice.' DE 'Decke Antwort und Erklärungen in allen Sprachen ab, bevor du A–C auswählst und begründest. Nach dem Ansehen der Antwort gilt der Versuch als unterstützte Übung.' Preserve the distinction from speaking assessment and the properly delayed transfer example.
